stories.title: Manchester United 4 Sabah 0
stories.details: Manchester United secured a dominant 4-0 victory over Sabah in the Champions League, with Kobbie Mainoo demonstrating his importance to Michael Carrick’s side. The win serves as a strong preparation for the upcoming Manchester Derby.

stories.title: Sesko soars as Manchester United surge past Sabah
stories.details: Benjamin Sesko played a key role in Manchester United's Champions League return, helping the team surge past Sabah. The performance highlights United's attacking depth as they re-enter continental competition.

stories.title: Barcelona thumps Feyenoord 5-1
stories.details: Barcelona opened their Champions League campaign with a dominant 5-1 victory over Feyenoord. Lamine Yamal was a standout performer, scoring a 21-yard free kick and providing two assists in a display of attacking panache.

stories.title: Real Madrid withstands late Inter threat
stories.details: In their Champions League opener, Real Madrid managed to secure a result despite a late surge from Inter. The match was part of the opening round of the expanded league phase featuring 36 teams.

stories.title: Manchester City wins first continental clash post-Pep
stories.details: Manchester City successfully navigated their first Champions League fixture following the departure of Pep Guardiola. The team secured a victory, marking a positive start to their new European campaign.

stories.title: Como v RB Leipzig Champions League debut
stories.details: Como is set to make their Champions League debut under the management of Cesc Fàbregas. The match against RB Leipzig is highly anticipated as a key fixture for the Italian side.

stories.title: England women’s Parkinson’s team heads to Canada
stories.details: Gemma Darvill is coaching the first England women’s Parkinson’s football team as they embark on a landmark tour to Toronto. The trip aims to raise awareness of the benefits of walking football for those living with the condition.

stories.title: Sabalenka reaches US Open final
stories.details: Aryna Sabalenka is on the brink of a US Open trifecta after a dominant performance against Jessica Pegula. She successfully blitzed her opponent to secure her place in the final.

stories.title: Anthony Joshua v Tyson Fury fight venue
stories.details: The Principality Stadium in Cardiff is the likely venue for the long-awaited heavyweight clash between Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury. The event is contingent on the Welsh government lifting the venue's 10.30pm curfew.

stories.title: Rory McIlroy at the Irish Open
stories.details: Rory McIlroy has expressed that Donald Trump’s presence at the Irish Open is a positive development. However, the tournament has faced criticism for a slow pace of play, with one of McIlroy's rounds lasting over six hours.

stories.title: JD Vance pitches himself as Trump’s political heir
stories.details: At the Republican midterm convention, JD Vance positioned himself as the successor to Donald Trump. He utilized populist rhetoric and echoed Trump’s talking points to energize the audience.

stories.title: Trump promises $5,000 checks
stories.details: President Trump has pledged to provide $5,000 checks to every American adult if his party retains control of Congress in the upcoming November elections. Analysts suggest the proposal may face significant hurdles.

stories.title: New York commemorates 25th anniversary of 9/11
stories.details: New York City held a solemn ceremony to mark the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks. The event served as a time for national reflection on the legacy and long-term impact of the tragedy.

stories.title: California signs online child safety bills
stories.details: Governor Gavin Newsom has signed landmark legislation in California aimed at enhancing online safety for children. The bills represent a significant move by the state to regulate digital platforms.

stories.title: Home Secretary addresses far-right protests
stories.details: The Home Secretary has instructed police chiefs to utilize new powers to ban masks at protests following recent anti-migrant demonstrations. Authorities are preparing for further activity in Portsmouth this weekend.

stories.title: Ed Miliband’s trade ban on Israeli settlements
stories.details: Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has faced both backlash and support for his decision to impose trade sanctions on Israeli settlements. The move has sparked intense debate within the Labour Party and internationally.

stories.title: Reform UK internal row
stories.details: Reform UK is currently experiencing internal conflict regarding the party's official response to the recent protests in Dover and Portsmouth. The disagreement highlights broader tensions within the party leadership.

stories.title: Bayeux Tapestry arrives at British Museum
stories.details: The historic Bayeux Tapestry has been moved to the British Museum for a major exhibition. The delicate transport process, involving advanced vibration-dampening technology, has sparked a national 'Bayeux mania' in Britain.

stories.title: UK economy beats growth expectations
stories.details: The UK economy grew by 0.4% in July, exceeding forecasts. Growth was driven by the services sector, an AI boom, and increased activity surrounding the men’s football World Cup.

stories.title: Apple launches iPhone Duo
stories.details: Apple has unveiled the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone, priced at $2,000. The device features a screen that unfolds to a size similar to an iPad mini and includes an under-display camera.

stories.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash AI model
stories.details: DeepSeek has launched a new multimodal AI model, V4.1-Flash, designed to reduce operational costs for long-context tasks. The model claims to outperform several frontier competitors in coding benchmarks.

stories.title: Global bond sell-off and inflation fears
stories.details: Global bond markets have experienced a sell-off as rising oil prices fuel concerns about persistent inflation. The European Central Bank has also raised interest rates in response to the economic climate.

stories.title: Automattic places CEO on leave
stories.details: The board of Automattic has placed founder and CEO Matt Mullenweg on a paid leave of absence. Mark Davies has been appointed as interim CEO amidst internal leadership disputes.
